name: Iota and Jot
summary: Chris Barker's minimal universal combinator languages (2001): Iota uses one combinator and one application symbol; Jot is a Gödel-numbering style binary language where every bit string is a program.

level_notes.1: Barker's original pages (nyu.edu/projects/barker/Iota) return 403 from the sandbox and are not linked.
level_notes.0: No verified implementation repository linked; implementations are listed on the esolangs.org page.
level_notes.2: Little secondary literature exists beyond the wiki/encyclopedia entries.
